fixture_strengthening.schema_basis: Existing sel-device-qualification/1 registry and accepted per-action evidence manifest fields; no separate versioned evidence-file schema is claimed.
fixture_strengthening.validity: Each temporary action digest resolves exact admitted file bytes; action operation UUID matches its admitted operation with action/fingerprint/checks/timestamp/outcome/raw receipt. Explicit test asserts valid registry/action acceptance.
fixture_strengthening.independent_negatives: Corrupt only digest OR only operation UUID; otherwise valid manifest remains unchanged.
fixture_strengthening.existing_firmware_case: When producing first auxiliary-firmware identity, update admitted evidence fingerprint plus file/action digests together; second identity still revokes consent.
fixture_strengthening.remaining_importer_gate: Author/run actual filesystem/SQLite/image custody, interruption/race/origin tests to meaningful behavioral RED before corresponding production validation/install functions. Absent CLI RED alone is not IC01..11 proof. No production root-override/test bypass.
